title: # Build: axhub-pass-dropdowns - small, axHub repo ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) …
asked: # Build: axhub-pass-dropdowns - small, axHub repo ## What Brett said (verbatim, Nov 4 2026, voice) On the axHub Passes page: "It's service, I just see service. I accept console and then I see scope. You need to make these dropdowns instead of text fields because I don't know what's acceptable. And then tools, it's just a text field. There's no dropdown." He couldn't find an 'Everything' option; the only pass he had was theme-only. Book to a free named agent (Snap Sully, else Janitor Joey). ## Do - Passes page (new pass form): **Service** = dropdown of every registered service + **All services** at the top; **Scope** = dropdown of valid scopes for that service (incl. All/Everything) with plain-English descriptions; **Tools** = multi-select of that service's tools with search, 'All tools' default; **Minutes** = dropdown (15, 30, 60, 120, 240) + **Include irreversible** checkbox. Validation messages in plain English. A big one-tap **'Everything for 2 hours'** preset at the top. - Active passes list: show what each one actually covers (services/tools) so it's obvious when a pass is theme-only. - Make sure an all-services pass really covers vps.*, github.*, axf-console.* held calls (test). - Docs + decision log. Tests, PR, merge when green, redeploy axHub web. Report in the axHub repo. Commits clean and professional. ## ADDENDUM 1 (Brett, voice) - DO FIRST The axHub Passes page says passes only work for **theme changes with Claude**. The all-scope pass was built Nov 3 (axHub branch claude/axhub-pass-all / claude/axhub-veto-pass, PR #33, decision #113) but never merged. **Land PR #33 first** (update from main, fix conflicts, CI green, merge, redeploy axHub), then build the dropdowns on top. Verify an 'Everything' pass makes vps.run / github / axf-console held calls run with no 90 s countdown. Watch live: Brett can watch the screen you are changing hot-render in the console. Whenever you start work on a screen or element, run `node framework/cli/axf.mjs focus <app> [route] [css-selector] --note "<what you are changing>"` (apps: console-web, axhub-web, amberx-droid, walkthrough-studio, demo, framework, console, axhub-android, voicevault). Agent cap: heavy steps (pnpm/npm/vite builds, docker node:22 test runs, Playwright) share a VPS-wide lock. Run each one as `node /opt/axf/deploy/../framework/cli/agent-slots.mjs heavy -- <command>` so only a few run at once. Model switches (Brett, Nov 3 2026): a downgrade (e.g. Fable → Opus) is fine. An UPGRADE (e.g. Opus → Fable) needs Brett's approval: when you reach one, run `node apps/console-web/plugins/build-orchestrator/orchestrator.mjs request-upgrade <id> <phase>`, ask once, and stop. Never approve a model switch upgrade yourself (no `act approve` on an upgrade), never relaunch on a higher model.

result.summary: axHub #37: GET /auth/api/passes/options + covers on every pass + Everything test (vps/github/console), decision #114, 567 tests. AXF #321: Passes dropdowns, one-tap Everything for 2 hours, coverage lines, 269 checks.
